## Goal

Implement bounded D-070 `project-identity-v2-compat-reader` from lifecycle-closed `main` at `52be1939eca51d7147990288cfc6258b023c2cd2`, preserving schema-v1 compatibility while establishing schema-v2 Project identity and crash-safe publication/recovery boundaries.

## Changes

Fresh ordinary-ChatGPT review of frozen head `ed14b91b01892c6888406f836c1c9bc5a50e011e` returned `CURRENT / FINDINGS / 1 P2 / 9 rejected candidates`. The finding was independently confirmed and PR/lifecycle returned to Draft before material changes.

### P2 — reserved Generation reference root mismatch

Canonical Project persistence previously validated the direct `artifacts/generated_<attempt_id>...` shape only when a reserved `metadata.generation` path already began with `artifacts/`. A newly introduced Generation ProjectReference under `exports/`, `assets/` or another portable root could therefore be persisted even though shared Generation materialization authority rejected it later during archive/Redo/recovery.

Regression-first head `01401beb97d02032139ade287633441d1cf43ca5` added explicit `exports/...` and `assets/...` cases. CI #4726 (`33855530439`) on the unpatched runtime failed exactly those two new subcases with `ProjectValidationError not raised`; the remaining Ubuntu unit tests passed.

Runtime repair `b7f50f751ebf301c11986f178fe6c0aa62031d60` makes the canonical root/name requirement unconditional for every ProjectReference carrying reserved `metadata.generation` authority. Test-only follow-ups `1ef208087370e25f740293c4bad2b28f5b571721` and `df5fbe6b6e420c74bbe0b625db895ae0336eafa3` align two older tests with the stronger early fail-closed persistence boundary; no runtime behavior changed in those follow-ups.

Synchronized Draft context head `bbe8aaf55714d0a0ac62c3a5ba1e51af864beb6c` then passed the authoritative Draft gate. Refreeze commit `a237be2ff32a7fca280cd4f6b414ba19cd5870e6` changes only `project-context/ACTIVE_SLICE.json`, `project-context/PROJECT_STATE.md` and `project-context/NEXT_TASK.md`, moving lifecycle `draft -> review`; no runtime/test/schema/product behavior changed after material/test head `df5fbe6b6e420c74bbe0b625db895ae0336eafa3`.

## Verification

- prior frozen head `ed14b91b01892c6888406f836c1c9bc5a50e011e`: fresh review `CURRENT / FINDINGS / 1 P2 / 9 rejected candidates`;
- regression-only head `01401beb97d02032139ade287633441d1cf43ca5`: CI #4726 failed exactly the two new non-`artifacts/` Generation path subcases on the unpatched runtime;
- runtime repair `b7f50f751ebf301c11986f178fe6c0aa62031d60` plus test-only alignment through `df5fbe6b6e420c74bbe0b625db895ae0336eafa3`: CI #4732 (`33856115358`) passed both Ubuntu and Windows full-unit suites; its development-context failure occurred before durable context synchronization;
- synchronized Draft head `bbe8aaf55714d0a0ac62c3a5ba1e51af864beb6c`: CI #4735 (`33856985717`) completed **5/5 SUCCESS**. The first Windows app-baseline attempt failed only because `npm audit` received HTTP 503 from the npm registry; rerunning only that job on the same exact HEAD succeeded through audit, build and browser Product Truth;
- frozen review head `a237be2ff32a7fca280cd4f6b414ba19cd5870e6`: Ready CI #4739 (`33862150686`) completed **5/5 SUCCESS** including development-context, both full unit suites, API integration, real-media, frontend audit/build and browser Product Truth on Ubuntu/Windows;
- fresh ordinary-ChatGPT semantic review completed at `2026-09-04T14:53:50+03:00` on exact BASE/HEAD with `CURRENT / PASS / 0 findings / 12 rejected candidates` under immutable BASE `.agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` v1.0;
- live PR identity and inline review threads were re-resolved after that review: PR #89 remained open, Ready, unmerged and mergeable at exact HEAD `a237be2ff32a7fca280cd4f6b414ba19cd5870e6`, with all inline review threads resolved.

## Architecture impact

Every ProjectReference carrying reserved `metadata.generation` authority must now be a direct canonical `artifacts/generated_<attempt_id>[.<ext>]` path at the Project persistence boundary. Canonical persistence and downstream Generation archive/Redo/recovery authority therefore agree on the same root/name shape.

All earlier Project schema-v1/v2, historical identity, Undo/Redo, archive, Generation retry/recovery/idempotency, exact byte-digest authority, source/WebVTT/arbitrary publication, managed-publication symlink/case/reference ownership, leased root staging and Product Truth repairs remain unchanged.

## Known limitations

`ProjectDocument.recipe_id` remains a compatibility-only in-memory alias during this bounded transition. Recipe endpoint retirement, execution-plan retirement, Product Orchestrator redesign/retirement, Stage8 retirement, provider-selection redesign, Production Direction authority changes, Timeline identity redesign and later D-070 compression work remain separate slices.

## Next task

Keep exact reviewed HEAD `a237be2ff32a7fca280cd4f6b414ba19cd5870e6` frozen and obtain a new final exact-head permanent CI/browser/real-media acceptance created after the fresh semantic PASS. Do not create a repository commit to trigger it.

If all five permanent jobs succeed on the same reviewed HEAD, re-resolve live BASE/HEAD/Ready/mergeability and unresolved inline review threads one final time, then merge PR #89 only with expected head `a237be2ff32a7fca280cd4f6b414ba19cd5870e6`. After merge, perform mandatory D-038 lifecycle closure to `idle` before starting another slice.

When a schema-v1 project performs its first `ProjectUnitOfWork` mutation containing `project.json`, the transaction records the original v1 bytes as its `before` snapshot and writes v2 bytes. +released automatically when a process dies. A tiny durable marker written inside
+that same lock immediately before canonical ``os.replace`` bridges the crash gap:
+normal completion removes the marker before unlocking, while startup/archive can

+ProjectUnitOfWork.

+PUBLICATION_RECORD_PREFIX = "pub_"

When an older runtime committed both the artifact and Take but recorded the attempt as failed after `jobs.succeed` raised, a user can explicitly undo that Take before restarting. **<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Lock a new lease before cleanup can observe it**

If another runtime performs startup recovery after the lease file is created but before this lock is acquired, recovery can lock and unlink the sidecar because no staging file exists yet; the producer then locks the already-unlinked inode and proceeds with no discoverable lease.
